rationale: LAMA0807 has no DiagnosticDefinition: the VerifyMetalamaLicense MSBuild task (Metalama.Licensing.BuildTasks) logs it with Log.LogWarning for every non-error LicensingMessage, and the text is produced by Metalama.Backstage licensing (LicenseConsumptionService, ExplicitLicenseSource, LicenseSourceBase, LicenseConsumer). There is no message in the Metalama.Premium repository to review.
